name: versioned-approval-invalidation
description: Introduces versioned v2 change manifests with append-only audit history and explicit materialized validity for spec approval, sign-off, and verification, while preserving read compatibility with legacy v1 manifests. Separates artifact reopening from workflow recovery, adds scope-aware and normalized whole-file implementation fingerprints, and centralizes reconciliation so gates and drift produce precise, phase-aware recovery. Exposes verification lifecycle commands and aligns CLI, skills, documentation, and archive preflight with the same validity protocol.
